name: REBT, Reglamento Electrotécnico para Baja Tensión (Spain)
references: Spain's Low Voltage Electrotechnical Regulation (REBT, Real Decreto 842/2002, BOE no. 224 of 18/09/2002), ITC-BT-10, item 3
note: A building's demand by this country's method (`building_demand`). The rest of the discipline comes from BIMCraft's library, and says so.

building_demand.source: Spain's Low Voltage Electrotechnical Regulation (REBT, Real Decreto 842/2002, BOE no. 224 of 18/09/2002), ITC-BT-10, item 3: a building's load is its dwellings' (the mean of their powers × the coefficient of Tabla 1) plus the general services, the shops and offices and the garages, these at a coefficient of 1. The powers are W at 230 V, given here in kW.

dwelling.source: ITC-BT-10, items 2.1 and 2.2: a dwelling's power is the one its owner plans, at least 5.75 kW; the grades basic and elevated

grades.name: basic
grades.source: ITC-BT-10, item 2.2: 5 750 W at 230 V, the least for a new dwelling

diversity.source: ITC-BT-10, Tabla 1 (item 3.1): the coefficient of simultaneity by the number of dwellings, and 15.3 + (n − 21)·0.5 above 21

premises.source: ITC-BT-10, item 3.3: shops and offices, 100 W/m², 3 450 W at least each, coefficient 1
ITC-BT-10, item 3.4: a garage with natural ventilation, 10 W/m², 3 450 W at least, coefficient 1
ITC-BT-10, item 3.4: a garage with forced ventilation, 20 W/m², 3 450 W at least, coefficient 1

notes: The general services (lifts, pumps, common lighting) count whole (item 3.2): give them in `common_demand`.
not_covered: a building on the night tariff, whose coefficient is the number of dwellings (item 3.1)
